title: Everyday Phrases — Swimming Lessons
title_quote: I want to learn to swim.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏊 實用游泳課必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Swimming Lessons
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的游泳課情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從報名問課、備齊泳鏡泳帽毛巾，到池邊憋氣吐泡泡、扶板打腿練換氣，再到游完一圈買泳衣約下節課，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Swimming Lessons phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from signing up for an adult beginner class and packing goggles, to blowing bubbles at the pool edge, kicking with a board, breathing to the side, and buying a swimsuit after your first lap. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to learn to swim.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This class is for new adults.
dialogue.zh: 這班專門給成人初學者。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To be honest, I cannot swim.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does one term cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay for just one class?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ fər dʒʌst wʌn klæs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I book my seat now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a towel too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a cap here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a small locker key.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my phone there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I give the key back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soap hangs on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warms up in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pool far from here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is loud in this room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hear the coach then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal on day one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone here a good swimmer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This group is all new learners.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is five to seven.
dialogue.zh: 還早呢，差五分鐘到七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, he starts at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can make it up later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card for the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ kɑːrd fər ðə fi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my group have a name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那讓初學者比較不緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I am ready to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow me to the pool side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The coach just called my name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say here and wave your hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it stops at your waist.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never swim in the deep end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take a big breath?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three feels like a long time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I put my face in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看吧，下面一點都不可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand up and rest a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not leave your side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your back is your best friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家一開始都聽到這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look like a log?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You float like a calm log.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個想法讓我安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I need to cough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn your face to the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spit it out, that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small sip will not hurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I keep water out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now bob up and down, try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up and down, up and down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I use my legs here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our quiet lane is great for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈkwaɪət leɪn ɪz ɡreɪt fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 這條安靜的泳道很適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did we do so far?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You passed the first hard test.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the board with straight arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lock your arms, keep them high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 板子會把我浮起來，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I keep my feet loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your face in the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not look at your legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the line is your road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mouth came out too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two chokes today, my face is red.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tʃoks təˈdeɪ, maɪ feɪs ɪz rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 今天嗆了兩次，臉都紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I can laugh a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse, then count kicks with me.
dialogue.zh: 先漱漱口，再跟我數打腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stop and float a while.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My board slid under my arms.
dialogue.zh: 我的板滑到胳膊底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest, and hang on the board.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, I sit on the step.
dialogue.zh: 現在我在扶梯上坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why can't we jump in here?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼我們不能在這裡跳水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 走進去、滑下去或用扶梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I float on my back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try first, I am right here.
dialogue.zh: 先試著自己來，我就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights spin when I panic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A long breath, and my back floats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔːŋ brɛθ, ænd maɪ bæk floʊts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the water holds you now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Arms come in the next class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I want to move faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 腿練穩了，手臂才遊得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smiles when you do well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my kick must look good.
dialogue.zh: 那我的打腿應該還不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more slow laps to finish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No board for my last lap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 只靠我自己的兩條胳膊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can do this, I am sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn du ðɪs, aɪ æm ʃʊr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And off I go from the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɔːf aɪ ɡoʊ frʌm ðə wɔːl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I reach forward and pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels like I sink deeper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide your hand in like butter.
dialogue.zh: 手像滑進奶油那樣入水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That picture works, I feel it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One whole lap! You did it!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want to swim it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，再一趟，然後喝熱可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在我想小小慶祝一下！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired and happy feel the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coach says my head is too high.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊtʃ sɛz maɪ hɛd ɪz tu haɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more lap, slow and tall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more lap, watch my arms.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits on the low shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 濕頭髮自然會乾成波浪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tie my hair up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is water in my ear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt your head to one side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那種感覺一會兒就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use a cotton swab?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never put one in your ear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens, water finds a way.
dialogue.zh: 難免啦，水總會找到出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop is by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess I need a second one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two suits, one is always dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift your arms, test the fit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does not pull or slip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my credit card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I come ten minutes early?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I will send the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next class we learn arms, finally!
dialogue.zh: 下堂課終於要學手臂了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the pool, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from zero to one full lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, frʌm ˈzɪroʊ tu wʌn fʊl læp./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，從零游到整整一趟。
